product_title: Premium Pink Lotus Toran with Pearl Tassels (38 inches)
product_description: Enhance your entrance with this beautifully handcrafted toran, featuring vibrant pink lotus motifs, decorative roses, intricate golden detailing, and elegant pearl tassels. Perfect for Diwali, festive celebrations, pooja rooms, and traditional home décor.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid water, moisture, and harsh chemicals.
Handle the pearl tassels and floral embellishments carefully.
Store flat in a dry place to preserve its shape and detailing.
